about: THE PAGE'S ONLY SETTINGS. Rewrite every line of coaching, swap the clip,
change the size, number or placement of targets, or the speed the
demonstration clip plays at, and nothing in the JavaScript changes.
DROP YOUR CLIPS IN media/ AND NAME THEM HERE. A named file that is not
there is reported on screen, by name, never silently skipped.
control is the interaction each lesson needs. The page reads which controls
the operator actually has switched on (GET /api/kiosk/status, then live
controls_changed) and says so by name instead of asking for something that
physically cannot happen.
The live camera view. roi_fill is how much of the circular mask the
tracked-hand crop is allowed to fill when the view zooms in: 0.66 means
the crop is never drawn wider than two thirds of the circle, so there is
always frame around it and it never reads as being zoomed too far.
The zoom is separately capped at 1:1, so the picture is never magnified
past native camera pixels whatever this is set to.
The target game. Buttons appear over the screen; the visitor clears them
with the gesture the page is teaching, then the page moves on.
`positions` are the target centres, in DESIGN PIXELS of the fixed
1920x1080 box. They are FIXED: the same three places every round, so the
visitor learns where to reach rather than hunting a new layout each time.
`avoid` (the camera circle) and `avoid_rects` (the left column: the armed
light, the star, the arrow keys and the clip; and the coaching line under
the camera) are no longer used to place anything. They are the CHECK: on
load the page reports any position that overlaps one, by name, in the
console.

copy.start: Move the cursor over the target, then click

lessons.title: Hit the targets
instructions: Hold one hand up, palm toward the screen, and point your index finger.
Move your fingertip to put the cursor on a target.
Tip your fingertip down, as if nodding it, and hold for a moment.
Clear all three targets to finish the round.

scale.label: Click
scale.hint_idle: Present a finger to bring the cursor up
scale.hint_working: Keep tipping the finger forward, and hold

scale.label: Wave
scale.hint_idle: Hold your open hand up, palm toward the screen

about: Lessons that are written but not shown. Move one into `lessons` to
bring it back. Nothing reads this key.
present / wave: parked when the page became a target game.
dial: also parked; it needs a media/dial.webm
clip, which has not been shot.
Their scoring paths (scalePose, scaleWave, scaleRotate and the
matching gate readouts) are all still in training.js and still work.

lessons.title: Present your index finger
instructions: Hold one hand up, at about chest height, palm toward the screen.
Point your index finger up and curl the other fingers in.
That is the whole gesture. A cursor appears and follows your fingertip.

scale.label: Finger presented
scale.hint_pass: That is it. The cursor is yours

lessons.title: Rotate the dial
instructions: Open your hand and spread your fingers apart.
Keep the palm toward the screen and roll your hand like turning a dial.
Roll clockwise to go up, counter-clockwise to go down.
Holding the roll keeps going, like holding a key down.

scale.label: Roll
scale.hint_idle: Open your hand and spread your fingers
scale.hint_learning: Hold still a moment while it learns your resting hand
